intro
Welcome to the Hindivine Patient App. Your health, guided by experts, right in your pocket.
overview
Here is everything the app can do for you, step by step.
download
Step one. Search for Hindivine on the Google Play Store. Tap Install, then open the app.
login
Step two. Log in securely with your mobile number. Enter the one time password, or simply continue with Google.
notify
Step three. Allow notifications, so you never miss a reply, a reminder, or your new diet chart.
home
Step four. Your home screen connects you directly with your Hindivine dietitian and care team.
chat
Step five. Chat privately with your dietitian. Ask questions, reply to any message, react with an emoji, and see when your message is read.
voice
Prefer speaking? Hold the mic to record a voice note in your own language, and play back replies anytime.
photos
Share photos of your meals, straight from your camera or gallery, so your dietitian can guide you better.
docs
Upload lab reports and documents, and open any P D F with a single tap.
videos
Watch videos shared by your care team, like exercise and recipe guides, right inside the app.
diet
Receive your personalised diet chart. One to seven days of meals, with a recipe for every dish, in your language.
share
Save charts and photos to your gallery, or share them with your family in one tap.
progress
Every week, share your check in, and get next week's chart with fresh new foods.
secure
Your account is protected with secure login, and your chats stay saved on your phone. The app even shows you when you are offline.
benefits
Expert guidance, personalised plans, and quick support. All in one premium app.
cta
Download the Hindivine Patient App on Google Play today. Hindivine. Your health, guided by experts.
